request.title: Lost your authenticator?
request.description: Use your current password and a verified email to set up a replacement authenticator.
email.hint: Enter your account’s main email address, even if you want the link sent to your backup address.
destination.backup: My backup email address (already confirmed here)
destination.hint: You can use your backup address only if you have already confirmed it on this website, in Settings.
recognized.hint: You will need your current password and an email address you have confirmed. For your safety, this option may not be available for every account.
sent.title: Check your email.
sent.description: If we can use this address for your account, a recovery link will arrive soon. It works for 30 minutes.
sent.hint: Have your replacement device and authenticator app ready before continuing. Your password stays the same.
link.title: Prepare your replacement.
link.description: Enter your current website password. After Continue, you have less than five minutes to set up the authenticator and save new recovery codes.
password.hint: We check it once and do not change it. This is not the password of your email account.
ready.device: My replacement device and authenticator app are ready
factor.title: Set up a replacement.
factor.description: Your existing authenticator stays active until you finish. Add the replacement as a separate entry.
totp.title: Add your replacement authenticator.
totp.description: Scan this QR code or enter the setup key in your replacement authenticator app, then verify its code.
qr.label: QR code for the replacement authenticator
qr.fallback: Use the setup key below if the QR code cannot be shown.
setup.hint: Use a time-based account. Keep this key private and keep your existing entry until recovery finishes.
codes.title: Save new recovery codes.
codes.description: Save all ten codes somewhere safe. They replace your old saved codes only when you finish.
codes.confirm: Enter one code from your saved copy
codes.hint: Save or download the whole set first. Read this code from the copy you saved.
ready.title: Almost done.
ready.description: When you continue, a 24-hour safety wait starts. Your current authenticator, recovery codes and signed-in sessions keep working until you finish from the link we email you.
waiting.title: For your safety, this finishes in 24 hours.
waiting.description: If this wasn't you, use the cancel link we emailed to all your addresses.
waiting.hint: Until then, your current authenticator, recovery codes and signed-in sessions keep working. When the 24 hours are over, we'll email you a link to finish. You will need your current password.
finishCheck.title: Checking your link.
finishWait.title: For your safety, this finishes in 24 hours.
finishWait.description: Open this link again after the time below. Until then, your current authenticator, recovery codes and signed-in sessions keep working.
finish.title: You can finish setting up your new authenticator now.
finish.description: Enter your current password to finish. Your old authenticator and old recovery codes then stop working, and every signed-in session is signed out.
finishClosed.title: This link can no longer be used.
finishClosed.description: The recovery may have been cancelled, finished already, or run out of time. It also stops if your password, email address or authenticator changed after it started.
finishClosed.hint: Nothing was changed by opening this link. Try signing in: if your new authenticator works, the recovery already finished. If not, you can start a new recovery.
done.title: Your authenticator is replaced.
done.description: Use the replacement entry and new saved recovery codes. Previous sessions, the old authenticator, and old recovery codes no longer work.
done.hint: Your website password stays the same. Wait for the next fresh code from the replacement authenticator before logging in.
restart.hint: Setup was interrupted. You can repeat this step until the time shown below; that time does not change.
cancel.title: Cancel this recovery?
cancel.description: If you cancel, you cannot start another recovery for 24 hours, with any method. Your current password and authenticator keep working, and you can still sign in as usual.
cancelled.title: Recovery cancelled.
cancelled.description: This request is closed. You can start a new recovery after 24 hours. Your current password and authenticator keep working.
expired.title: This recovery expired.
expired.description: The short replacement session or email link can no longer be used. Request a new link when your device and app are ready.
refused.title: This recovery cannot be used here.
refused.description: We could not approve this recovery. If you have an unused saved recovery code, you can use it instead.
alreadyWaiting.title: A recovery is already in progress.
alreadyWaiting.description: Use the link in the email we sent you, or cancel it from that email.
saved.link: Recover with a saved recovery code
saved.hint: Use this if you saved an unused recovery code, including when you do not know your password.
known.link: Know your password but lost your authenticator?
known.hint: Use your current password and a previously verified email to replace it.
switch.title: Switch recovery method?
switch.description: Close this recovery before you try another way. Your current password and authenticator keep working.
switch.unknown: We could not confirm that the request was cancelled. Check its status before switching. An expired page does not mean the request was closed.
switch.pending: Open the current recovery email link first, then cancel the request before choosing another method.
error.proof: That password or code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.code: Enter the six-digit code from the requested authenticator. Spaces are accepted when pasting.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.unknown: We could not tell whether this worked. Check the recovery status before trying again.
backup.title: Backup email address
backup.description: Confirm the backup address on your account so you can use it to get back in if you lose your authenticator. This does not change the address.
backup.unavailable: There is no backup address to confirm.
backup.sent: If everything checks out, a link will arrive at your backup address. Open it to finish confirming the address.
backup.error: We could not check the backup address. Check its status before asking for another link.
backup.link.title: Confirm your backup email.
backup.link.description: Continue to confirm this address for your account. Your password and authenticator stay the same.
backup.done.title: Backup email confirmed.
backup.done.description: You can now use this address to get back into your account if you lose your authenticator.
backup.expired.title: This verification link is unavailable.
backup.expired.description: This link has expired or was already used. You can ask for a new one in Settings.
backup.confirm.unknown: We could not tell whether this worked. Press Check confirmation before trying anything else.
cancel.pause: If you cancel, you cannot start another recovery for 24 hours, with any method. Your current password and authenticator keep working, and you can still sign in as usual.
deadline.unknown: Time ran out before we could tell whether this worked. Your password has not changed. Try signing in to see which authenticator works.
